./src/ezinsar/api/THEIAapi

This script is based on the scripts from Olivier Hagolle https://github.com/olivierhagolle/theia_download

For Doris, EZ-InSAR writes the input files based on the Doris inputs and Doris documentation.

For ISCE-2, EZ-InSAR writes the input files based on the ISCE-2 examples.

For LicSBAS, EZ-InSAR writes the parameter descriptions based on the LicSBAS examples.

For MintPy, EZ-InSAR writes the parameter descriptions based on the MintPy examples.

For SNAP, EZ-InSAR writes the parameter descriptions based on the SNAP documentation.

For StaMPS, EZ-InSAR writes the parameter descriptions based on the StaMPS documentation.

The EZ-InSAR documentation is based on the examples of pydoctor.
